name: syncEHRData
shortDescription: Synchronizes patient medical data with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system for data consistency.
description:
Overview

Pushes or pulls patient medical data to/from an external EHR system to maintain data consistency across platforms.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler when a MedicalRecord is updated internally, or as a scheduled job for periodic synchronization. It receives the updated MedicalRecord data.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the MedicalRecord data that needs synchronization from the event context or database.
  2. Prepare the data in the specific format required by the EHRSystem's API (e.g., FHIR, RESTful JSON).
  3. Call the EHRSystem external service using ctx.service('EHRSystem').call_api to send or retrieve data.
  4. Handle API responses, logging success or failure of the synchronization.
  5. Audit-log the synchronization attempt and its outcome using ctx.audit.log.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord

External Services

  • EHRSystem
